facts: Roughly 180 yards of original land face survive west of the modern road, including the addition of three reconstructed traverses. A separate 75-yard original fragment lies east of the road. Battle Acre Monument is on the ocean side.
Records the June 1932 dedication of the Battle Acre column.

record: Fort Fisher National Historic Landmark designation inventory
facts: Identifies the 1932 column with its eagle finial at Battle Acre.
